properties.title: Pumptrack Flims
properties.abstract: The 90 m pump track in the centre of Flims offers over 29 rollers and a wide variety of turns. It is suitable for mountain bikes, dirt bikes, BMX, skateboards, and scooters. An optimal outdoor training facility throughout the summer for children and adults, both beginners and advanced riders.
properties.name: Gästeinformation Flims Laax Falera

de.abstract: Der 90 Meter lange Pumptrack im Herzen von Flims verfügt über 29 Wellen und variantenreiche Kurven. Befahrbar ist er mit Mountainbikes, Dirtbikes, BMX, Skateboards und Scootern. Kinder, Erwachsene Einsteiger wie auch gestandene Profis finden hier den ganzen Sommer lang optimale Outdoor-Trainingsmöglichkeiten.

fr.abstract: Le pump track de 90 mètres de long au cœur de Flims propose 29 bosses et des virages aux multiples variantes. Il est praticable en VTT, dirtbike, BMX, skateboard et trottinette. Enfants, adultes débutants et professionnels confirmés y trouveront durant tout l’été des possibilités optimales d’entraînement en plein air.

it.abstract: Il pump track lungo 90 metri che sorge nel cuore di Flims presenta 29 onde e curve di vario genere. È percorribile in mountain bike, dirt bike, BMX, skateboard e scooter. Qui, bambini, adulti principianti e veri esperti trovano durante tutta l'estate condizioni di allenamento all'aperto ottimali.
